fsi_isfr.name: Forest Survey of India — India State of Forest Report (ISFR)
fsi_isfr.organization: Forest Survey of India (FSI), Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
fsi_isfr.forest_definition: All lands, more than one hectare in area, with a tree canopy density of more than 10 percent irrespective of ownership and legal status. Includes orchards, bamboo, and palms.

canopy_classes.Scrub: Degraded forest lands with canopy density < 10%

hansen_gfc.name: Global Forest Change (Hansen/UMD/Google/USGS/NASA)
hansen_gfc.organization: University of Maryland Global Land Analysis and Discovery (GLAD) lab
hansen_gfc.forest_definition: Tree cover defined as all vegetation taller than 5 meters in height. Tree-cover loss is defined as stand-replacement disturbance or complete canopy removal at 30m resolution.
hansen_gfc.caveats: Does NOT distinguish permanent deforestation from rotational plantation harvesting, shifting cultivation, or fire disturbance. Canopy loss does not directly equal individual felled trees.

isro_bhuvan_lulc.name: ISRO Bhuvan Land Use / Land Cover (SISDP-2 & National LULC)
isro_bhuvan_lulc.organization: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
isro_bhuvan_lulc.license: ISRO Data Policy (Open WMS Thematic Services)

esa_worldcover.name: ESA WorldCover 10m Global Land Cover
esa_worldcover.organization: European Space Agency (ESA) & VITO Remote Sensing

sentinel2_msi.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI MultiSpectral Instrument
sentinel2_msi.spatial_resolution: 10 meters (B2 Blue, B3 Green, B4 Red, B8 NIR)
